pattern: A repair producer returns the input artifact unchanged on a valid no-op branch but exits before publishing the same typed after-state census required from changed candidates, leaving the consumer unable to distinguish a measured identity result from missing evidence.
docstring: Require every valid post-route repair result, including an unchanged no-op identity result, to publish typed before, after, and added unrouted-net counters from the producer.
fix_action: In the no-op producer branch, measure and emit the final unrouted-net census and the set difference before returning the input state. Keep the existing consumer refusal for absent, negative, or inconsistent counters; never infer zero in the consumer.
